items.title: The Capture
items.reason: Manipulated video evidence and deepfakes turn every recording into a question - the strongest realisation of 'can you trust what you are shown'.

items.title: Mr. Robot
items.reason: A hacker conspiracy told through a narrator who cannot be trusted, reframing itself continuously.

items.title: Line of Duty
items.reason: Anti-corruption investigators hunting bent police, with interrogation scenes that keep detonating new information.

items.title: Oldboy
items.reason: Fifteen years imprisoned, five days to find out why - a revenge puzzle that rebuilds itself to the last minute.

items.title: Black Bird
items.reason: An inmate sent undercover to win a suspected killer's confession, in a sustained two-hander of manipulation.

items.title: Severance
items.reason: Workers surgically split between office and outside life, with the mystery of what the company wants deepening every episode.

items.title: Memento
items.reason: An anterograde-amnesia revenge story told backwards, so every scene reframes the one you just watched.

items.title: The Usual Suspects
items.reason: A police interrogation reconstructing a massacre, with a final reversal that rewrites everything preceding it.

items.title: The Night Agent
items.reason: A low-level agent pulled into a White House conspiracy with a mole, running at constant forward momentum.

items.title: Dexter
items.reason: A forensic analyst who is himself the killer, working beside the investigators hunting him.

items.title: Knives Out
items.reason: A locked-room whodunnit that hands the audience its solution early and keeps complicating it anyway.

items.title: Gone Girl
items.reason: A disappearance that turns into a study of two people performing themselves for an audience.

items.title: Searching
items.reason: A father reconstructs his missing daughter's life entirely through her screens and accounts.

items.title: Dark
items.reason: A small-town disappearance that opens into a multi-generational time puzzle with relentless revelation.

items.title: The Prestige
items.reason: Rival magicians escalating deception against each other, with concealed identity as the mechanism.

items.title: Bodyguard
items.reason: A veteran assigned to protect a minister he may not be able to trust, sustained at near-unbearable tension.

items.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
items.reason: A journalist and a hacker reopen a decades-cold family disappearance and assemble it from archives.

items.title: Squid Game
items.reason: A rule-bound lethal tournament where the psychology of the players matters as much as the games.

items.title: Se7en
items.reason: Two detectives tracking a killer staging murders around the deadly sins - bizarre cases, worked methodically.

items.title: The Invisible Man
items.reason: An abusive ex who cannot be seen, and the sustained impossibility of proving what is happening.

items.title: Slow Horses
items.reason: Disgraced MI5 agents in an administrative dead end, pulled into a conspiracy that keeps escalating.

items.title: Shutter Island
items.reason: A marshal investigating a disappearance on an asylum island, where the ground shifts under the investigation.

items.title: Homeland
items.reason: A CIA analyst convinced a returned prisoner of war has been turned, with the doubt never settling.

items.title: Prisoners
items.reason: A father takes the investigation into his own hands while the official one continues in parallel.

items.title: True Detective
items.reason: Two detectives across two timelines, chasing a ritualistic case whose strangeness never resolves cleanly.

items.title: You
items.reason: A bookseller's obsessive pursuit narrated from inside his own justifications.

items.title: The Bourne Identity
items.reason: An amnesiac assassin reverse-engineering his own identity while the programme hunts him.

items.title: A Simple Favor
items.reason: A vlogger investigating her friend's disappearance, with deception layered under every relationship.

items.title: Tenet
items.reason: Inverted-entropy espionage where understanding the rules is inseparable from following the plot.

items.title: Zodiac
items.reason: A decades-long hunt built on ciphers, handwriting and dead ends - the puzzle itself is the subject.

items.title: Primal Fear
items.reason: An altar boy accused of murder, with a courtroom defence resting on which version of him is real.

items.title: Unbelievable
items.reason: Two detectives connect serial assaults across jurisdictions while a disbelieved victim is prosecuted.

items.title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan
items.reason: A CIA analyst pulled into the field, chasing financial traces into an active conspiracy.

items.title: Mare of Easttown
items.reason: A small-town detective working a murder while her own life collapses around the case.
